alternativeSelection.assessment: Three distinct programmes address broad social research, institutional inequality, and the social and behavioural determinants of health. All pass the pairwise distinctness and feasibility checks.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both study gender, sexuality and power. UCR uses North American historical sources and oral histories.
Both introduce sociological explanations of inequality, cohesion and culture.
Both conduct a qualitative project from research question to data collection and interpretation.
Both use social theory to explain relationships between action and social structures. UvA integrates several social-science disciplines.
Both study group influence, attitudes and behaviour. UvA also introduces cognition, learning and motivation.
Both select statistical methods, analyse data and interpret results. UCR uses behavioural datasets and UvA develops a broader social-science research project.
Both plan a systematic literature search, select and appraise evidence, and synthesise findings. UCR uses meta-analysis, while UvA integrates perspectives across social-science disciplines.

Explicitly unmatched after semantic review: no scheduled UCR course was judged a sufficiently direct counterpart to Schaal, plaats en ruimte.
Both introduce political science through comparative study of institutions, actors and participation.
Both study the causes of conflict and compare approaches to peacebuilding across disciplines.
Both study policy formation, decisions, implementation and evaluation. UvA adds a group investigation of an applied policy problem.
Both develop academic reading, writing and reflection. UvA teaches these in a short tutored practicum.
Both teach study design, data collection and basic analysis. UvA also studies social research traditions and qualitative methods.
Explicitly unmatched after semantic review: no scheduled UCR course was judged a sufficiently direct counterpart to Academische vaardigheden: Practicum 2.

notes.text: UvA combines sociology, psychology, political science, anthropology and human geography in one degree. UCR offers related social science and research, while UvA provides dedicated anthropology and urban geography courses and a required sequence of integration practica.

audience.programmeDescription: Interdisciplinary Social Science at the University of Amsterdam brings five social sciences together to investigate problems such as inequality and sustainability. Students learn qualitative and quantitative methods, apply them in projects and complete an individual thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR options focus on broad social research, inequality and public policy, or the social and behavioural determinants of health. UvA combines these kinds of questions with dedicated anthropology, human geography and interdisciplinary fieldwork.
